_comment: Manual decisions for casus candidates the automatic direction check could not settle (src/casus.py). Key = id of the consilium that currently ends with the block (owner). decision: move -> block becomes the casus of the next consilium; keep -> block stays in the owner. Decided 2026-09-23 by reading the Latin (Claude, not the editor); not editor-verified.

casus (tutela: maternal grandfather vs mother) is exactly v2-385's question. NOTE data anomaly: a mis-tagged heading fragment 'CONSILIVM CCCLXXXIIII.' sits inside this block and consilium 384 does not exist as a separate record; check the page image
